source.constructor: original Q source through original frozen W build bytecode, only cohort binding changes

Wingless.validation_only: Original F124-W fit-selected checksum (1,3,4,2) remains fixed; no selection again. Frozen V checksum (1,2,3,4) and original learned T plus fixed12of16 are controls; exact logits of indexed-primary equal uncached V across every new FIT+DEV case.

benchmark.measure: perf_counter_ns per case wall time, tracemalloc per graph peak Python allocated bytes, median and p95 for pairwise same-case timing; sampled across 7/8/9 without tuning. Report environment/python/runner architecture, cache entries, 4 channels, 5 bins, 3/node state and max total 192. No hardware-equivalent speed or matched-memory superiority claim.

Yggdrasil.diagnostic_only: Run authentic frozen T rank-only and V centered per-hop observers source-blind on new positive and negative public graphs; exact logits and operation counters must equal untouched originals. After model returns, join positive-only symbolic witness to public cell trace, census survival, evictions and paired score drifts hop by hop.
Yggdrasil.counterfactual: From the frozen V trace's identical final target accumulated value, change ONLY divisor from depth to (depth-1), preserving original learned bias and factor 4; no threshold tune, rank/state/score update change, and no use of labels in forward.
Yggdrasil.score_drift: For same raw-key-positive witness (node,bits), compare V score versus T score at each hop; also report terminal readout margin for both and for frozen normalization counterfactual; no last-stage score tuning.
